name: MedSP1000
intro: MedSP1000 是由 MedEdPORTAL 标准化病人教学材料转化而来的交互式临床 Agent 基准。论文从 613 篇可仿真文章构建 1,638 个病例、17 个专科和 24,602 条 ACGME rubric；总体与专科按病例宏平均，但能力维度在第 2.1.3 节写评分项微平均、第 4.3 节公式 3 又写病例宏平均，页面保留这一内部冲突并另列发布与运行漂移。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
build_method: 标准化病人案例改造, 专家rubric, 交互式仿真
metric: 病例宏平均Rubric完成率；专科病例宏平均；能力维度定义冲突（评分项微平均 vs 病例宏平均）
task_type: 医疗Agent任务, 临床对话, 过程级评估
eval_feature: 动态临床决策, 信息收集, 治疗规划, 纵向管理
scale: 论文：1638个病例、17个专科、24602条rubric；固定HF快照：1639个场景路径
task_type_en: Medical agent task, Clinical dialogue, Process-level evaluation
build_method_en: Standardized patient case adaptation, Expert Rubrics, Interactive Simulation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic clinical decision-making, Information gathering, Treatment planning, Longitudinal management
intro_en: MedSP1000 is an interactive clinical-agent benchmark derived from MedEdPORTAL standardized-patient teaching materials. The paper builds 1,638 cases across 17 specialties with 24,602 ACGME rubric items from 613 simulation-valid articles. Overall and specialty scores are case-macro, but competency aggregation conflicts internally: Section 2.1.3 pools rubric items while Section 4.3 Equation 3 averages per-case ratios. This page preserves that conflict and separately marks release and runtime drift.
scale_en: Paper: 1,638 cases, 17 specialties, 24,602 rubrics; pinned HF snapshot: 1,639 scenario paths
metric_en: Case-macro rubric completion; specialty case-macro completion; competency definition conflict (item-micro vs case-macro)

drawio_review_note: Source audit completed against arXiv:2606.05112v1, especially Sections 2.1.1-2.1.3 and 4.1-4.3 plus Figures 1, 7, and 8, the fixed official code snapshot https://github.com/MAGIC-AI4Med/MedSP1000/tree/2806984cb331d6fedc2c0555e3c1c4a54171c77a, and the fixed data snapshot https://huggingface.co/datasets/byrLLCC/MedSP1000/tree/55e3e55efd08c73baab912ba0c5b42637114fbc8. The paper searches MedEdPORTAL with “simulation case” and “standardized patient,” yielding 1,073 articles and 22,244 attachments. It directly retains 931 text-extractable articles and manually reviews 142 multimodal articles, retaining 86 and discarding 56 for a total of 1,017. MarkItDown handles structured Office files, MinerU2 plus OCR handles DOC/PDF, and unchanged text formats complete 7,147 Markdown files. Codex judges 613 articles simulation-valid, splits independent encounters into 1,638 cases across 17 specialties, performs copy-and-delete construction of four role packets, and iteratively audits leakage, portrayal sufficiency, and consistency. Scoring points are copied verbatim, frozen, and mapped into six ACGME competencies, yielding 24,602 items. Twelve clinicians validate 100 constructed cases and 100 completed runs, with two raters per case or run; construction corrections form MedSP1000-Verified. At runtime the assessed clinician receives scenario initialization and emits speak, actions, and eos; the patient handles scripted dialogue, while the controller resolves source-defined state transitions and marks unsupported results instead of fabricating them. The evaluator makes a binary completed/not-completed judgement for every frozen item from the full trajectory. Overall completion is the equal-case macro average and specialty reporting also averages cases. Competency aggregation is internally inconsistent: Section 2.1.3 describes pooling all rubric items assigned to a competency, an item-micro definition, while Section 4.3 Equation 3 explicitly averages the per-case competency ratios, a case-macro definition. The paper does not reconcile the two, so neither is silently selected as the sole contract. Official release drift is material: the pinned HF scenario_index lists 1,639 scenario paths, while the pinned code repository contains 1,638 rubric filenames and four are zero bytes, leaving 1,634 parseable rubric files. The paper specifies no fixed turn cap and temperature 0 for evaluated agents, but the pinned repository example sets max_total_turns to 12 and the default API path leaves temperature unset unless a test-time strategy activates a fixed temperature; the paper uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro for patient/environment agents, while the repository example defaults all roles to GPT-5.5. Rights labels conflict: the paper says the dataset is CC BY-NC-SA and code CC BY-SA under original MedEdPORTAL terms, while the pinned HF card and repository LICENSE label MIT and the latter still contains placeholder copyright text. These differences are reported, not silently treated as the paper protocol. Formal publication evidence [site-a11u-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1645×825 (English) and 1645×825 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1643×823 and 1643×823. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
